datacolumn.scope: name of data column to be used `["data", "float_data", or "corrected"]`

overwrite.scope: allow to overwrite the output file if already exists.

field.scope: Select fields. Use field id(s) or name(s).

timerange.scope: Range of time to select from data

outputspw.scope: select spws to output, same syntax of spw.("" = all)

gainfactor.scope: Gain factor to multiply correction term.

h0.scope: scale height for water [km], e.g. 2.0. ("" = Tool default)

atmdetail.scope: Expose parameters for detailed configuration of ATM model if True.

behaviors.title: Open and select a total-power MeasurementSet
behaviors.scope: Resolve selected autocorrelation rows and polarization and read the requested data plane. Apply correction to eligible on-source integrations.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Resolve independent processing and output windows
behaviors.scope: Correct the intersection of processing and output windows. Preserve other output windows and map each output spectrum to its original channels.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Apply calibration-derived gain
behaviors.scope: Accept the scalar, per-window mapping, or a calibration table. Apply the window gain to the additive atmospheric correction.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Use measured weather, pointing, and the atmospheric profile
behaviors.scope: Use recorded ambient conditions by default and allow explicit site and atmospheric overrides. Interpolate pointing, link target and reference elevations, and use the native atmospheric model and measured band response.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Configure detailed ATM layers
behaviors.scope: Accept profile and layer quantities, default values and unit strings. The pinned layer model accepts a pressure factor but computes with a fixed factor of 1.075.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Publish an interoperable corrected MeasurementSet
behaviors.scope: Write the selected MeasurementSet, including unchanged imaginary components, flags and weights. Stage the replacement until processing succeeds.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale release profiling follows functionality under #979.

decisions.record: An empty atmospheric correction window selection raises a record-type error
decisions.casa: The empty NumPy record list is inferred as floating point and rejected.
decisions.ours: Use a typed empty window list and write the selected spectra unchanged.
decisions.rationale: There are zero eligible windows for correction.
decisions.impact: Disjoint processing and output selections produce the selected data.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: Atmospheric correction can index a cropped window from channel zero
decisions.casa: Subtracts corrections computed for channels 0 through 18 from the selected output channels.
decisions.ours: Subtract the correction at each original selected channel.
decisions.rationale: Original frequency determines the atmospheric signature; the corrected output matches the same channels of a full-window correction.
decisions.impact: Cropped spectra agree with the requested ordered projection of the full corrected product.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: Atmospheric correction can publish unflagged nonfinite spectra
decisions.inputs: Use a calibration table with zero amplitude or a scalar factor of 1e40 for SPW 19.
decisions.casa: The corrected MeasurementSet contains unflagged nonfinite samples.
decisions.ours: Refuse nonfinite gains and corrections outside the Float32 range before publication.
decisions.rationale: A gain factor cannot make a finite input spectrum invalid without an error.
decisions.impact: A failed overwrite preserves an existing finite product.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

paired.kind: ALMA total-power atmospheric correction, spectrum invariants, and MeasurementSet interchange
paired.scope: All 29 task arguments and three direct atmcor arguments, including original, corrected and floating-point spectra, independent window queries, worked quantities and profile overrides, weather and pointing, combined selectors, gain factors, flags and weights, and reads in both table implementations.
paired.result: On the pinned X320b_sel2.ms fixture, measured correction normalized RMS across 1,648 spectra is 2.82e-4. Gain, channel and equal-elevation laws pass, alongside a dry atmosphere, antenna-pair selection and transactional publication.
